741: and do not serve the Creator. ॥1॥
O God, Your Name purifies sinners.
Save me, who am without virtue. ॥1॥ Rahao
O God, You are the Giver, the Knower of hearts,
yet we mortals take pride in this perishable body. ॥2॥
Cravings, quarrels, envy and the pride of Maya:
ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ; ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
attached to these, we waste the jewel of human life. ॥3॥
O Destroyer of pain, Life of the world, Lord and King,
leaving all else, Nanak has come to Your refuge. ॥4॥13॥19॥
ਪੇਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਅੰਧਾ; ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Though he sees and tastes, he is called blind; though he hears, he does not hear the Lord's praise.
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰੇ; ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
He thinks the treasure that is near is far away; the sinner keeps committing sins. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
O mortal, do something by which you may be saved.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name; the Bani of His praise gives spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao
You are ever absorbed in love of horses and mansions,
but none of these will go with you. ॥2॥
You keep this clay vessel of the body plastered and polished,
but within it is utterly filthy, and it will receive Death's punishment. ॥3॥
You are bound by lust, anger, greed and attachment,
sinking ever deeper into the great pit. ॥4॥
O my God, hear Nanak's prayer;
The one who remains dead to the world while yet alive comes to know God.
That person receives Him by His grace. ॥1॥
Listen, O friend: this is how the treacherous ocean is crossed,
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meeting the Guru and chanting the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one who knows no other but the One
recognises the Supreme Lord within every heart. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
The one who accepts as good whatever He does
comes to know the worth of the Lord, eternal from beginning to end. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: I am a sacrifice to that person
in whose heart You, O Lord, dwell. ॥4॥15॥21॥
The Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Creator,
who gives support to the whole world. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ; ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O mind, meditate on the Guru's lotus feet,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ; ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and pain and suffering will leave this body. ॥1॥ Rahao
The True Guru pulls out those drowning in the world-ocean,
and reunites those separated for countless births. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Serve the Guru day and night,
and peace, poise and tranquillity will come to the mind. ॥3॥
Only by great good fortune does one receive the dust of the True Guru's feet.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੨॥
Nanak: then one is ever a sacrifice to the Guru. ॥4॥16॥22॥
Be a sacrifice to your Guru,
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
and twenty-four hours a day sing the Lord's praise. ॥1॥
the Knower of all hearts. ॥1॥ Rahao
Love has arisen for His lotus feet;
this is the true, perfect and pure way of life. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace, He comes to dwell in the mind,
and the sins of countless births depart. ॥3॥
O God, merciful to the meek, show mercy;
Nanak begs for the dust of the saints' feet. ॥4॥17॥23॥
742: Beholding your vision, O Guru, I come alive.
O my God, may Your perfect grace be upon me. ॥1॥
O my God, hear this prayer:
ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
make me Your servant and give me Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
O God, Great Giver, keep me in Your refuge.
By the Guru's grace, only a rare one has come to know You. ॥2॥
O God, my Friend, hear my prayer:
may Your lotus feet dwell in my mind. ॥3॥
O perfect Lord, treasure of virtues, may I never forget You. ॥4॥18॥24॥
The Lord is my friend, companion, son, relative and brother.
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Wherever I look, the Lord is with me as my helper. ॥1॥
ਜਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ; ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
The Lord's Name is my caste, my honour and my wealth.
In it I find peace, poise, bliss and rest. ॥1॥ Rahao
Meditate on the Supreme Lord and wear it as armour;
millions of weapons cannot pierce it. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣ; ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
The refuge of the Lord's feet is my fortress and stronghold;
ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਜਮੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
painful Death cannot break it down. ॥3॥
Nanak is ever a sacrifice to Your servants,
the saints of the Lord, the King, the Destroyer of pride. ॥4॥19॥25॥
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
Let us ever sing the praises of God, the Sustainer of the world.
Those who sing them have bliss, delight, joy and peace. ॥1॥
Come, O companion, let us go to enjoy God,
ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and fall at the feet of the holy. ॥1॥ Rahao
Let us pray and beg for the dust of the feet of His servants,
and wash away the sins of countless births. ॥2॥
Let us offer mind, body, breath and soul,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਾਹਾਂ ॥੩॥
and remembering the Lord again and again, cut away pride and attachment. ॥3॥
O Lord, merciful to the meek, give me this zeal,
that Nanak, Your servant, may stay merged in Your refuge. ॥4॥20॥26॥
Where the saints dwell, that is the city of heaven.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
There God's lotus feet dwell in the heart. ॥1॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ; ਤੁਝੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
Listen, O mind and body, let me show you true peace.
ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ; ਤੁਝੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let me feed you the many delicacies of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
Savour the amrit Name within your mind;
ਅਚਰਜ ਸਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੇ; ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
its wondrous tastes cannot be described. ॥2॥
Greed has died, and the fire of desire is quenched,
for those servants who have sought the refuge of the Supreme Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ; ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
He has dispelled the fears and attachments of countless births.
Nanak: God has shown mercy to His servants. ॥4॥21॥27॥
God has removed the many crooked ways of His servant,
and in His mercy made him His own. ॥1॥
ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ; ਜਾਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who was caught in the net of the dream-like world. ॥1॥ Rahao
Faults as huge and terrible as mountains
the Merciful One removed in an instant. ॥2॥
Sorrow, disease and the heaviest calamities
departed by chanting the Name of the Lord. ॥3॥
Casting His glance of grace, He attached him to the hem of His robe.
743: Nanak: he grasped the Lord's feet and sought His refuge. ॥4॥22॥28॥
The one whom He turns away from the true faith and attaches to the world
is called a sinner in both worlds. ॥1॥
He Himself knows His own creation. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one whom He inspires to practise true righteousness and do good,
ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਤੋਸੈ; ਦੁਨੀ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
gathering the provisions of faith, does not lose this world either. ॥2॥
Within all, the One alone is awake.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
As He attaches each one, so is each one attached. ॥3॥
My Master is unreachable, beyond the senses, and true.
Nanak speaks as You make him speak. ॥4॥23॥29॥
At dawn, chant the Lord's Name,
and build a fine shelter for this world and the next. ॥1॥
Chant the Lord's Name for ever and ever,
ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and the desires of the mind will be fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao
Sing of the imperishable God night and day;
remaining detached while yet alive, you will attain the eternal place. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Serve that Banker whose wealth never runs short.
Using it and sharing it, life passes in peace and bliss. ॥3॥
That one has found the all-pervading Lord, the Life of the world,
Nanak, who by the Guru's grace meditated on the Name in the holy congregation. ॥4॥24॥30॥
When the Perfect Guru becomes merciful,
one's efforts bear fruit and all pains are destroyed. ॥1॥
Beholding Your vision again and again, I live.
I am a sacrifice to Your lotus feet.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without You, O Master, who is mine? ॥1॥ Rahao
Love for the holy congregation has welled up
in the one whose destiny, written by past deeds, has awakened from the start. ॥2॥
ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name; wondrous is its glory.
The three fevers cannot burn the one who chants it. ॥3॥
ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, may I never forget Your feet even for an instant;
O Beloved, Nanak begs for this gift. ॥4॥25॥31॥
O my Beloved, bring about such an occasion
that my tongue may chant Your Name. ॥1॥
Hear my prayer, O God, merciful to the meek:
ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
as the holy ever sing Your delightful praises, so may I. ॥1॥ Rahao
O God, remembering You is life itself.
ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
On whom You show mercy, You dwell near to them. ॥2॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ; ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਹਾਰੁ ॥
Your Name is the food that satisfies the hunger of Your servants.
You are the Great Giver, O God, who alone can give it. ॥3॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, the saints enjoy peace;
Nanak, He is the wise and all-knowing Giver. ॥4॥26॥32॥
ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ; ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ. ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
Your life is flowing away, yet you never notice it.
You keep tying the bundles of false attachment. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Lord of Maya day and night, always.
ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Win the prize of human life by seeking the Lord's refuge. ॥1॥ Rahao
You commit sins with both hands, without a thought,
ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ; ਰਿਦ. ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਰਤ ॥੨॥
and do not keep the jewel of the Lord's Name in your heart even for an instant. ॥2॥
Your life passes in feeding and caring for the body,
744: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
and you have not known the joyful state of praising the Lord of the world. ॥3॥
I have sought Your refuge, O all-powerful Master beyond the senses;
Nanak: save me, O God, Knower of hearts. ॥4॥27॥33॥
In the company of the holy one crosses the terrifying world-ocean,
remembering the Lord's Name, the mine of jewels. ॥1॥
Remembering the Lord again and again, I live.
ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ. ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meeting the Perfect Guru, all pain, disease and sorrow are destroyed, and sins are cast off. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Lord's Name is the state of true life.
Mind and body become pure, and the True One becomes the purpose of life. ॥2॥
Meditate on the Supreme Lord twenty-four hours a day;
but this is found only if it is written from the past. ॥3॥
Those who chant the Name of the Lord, merciful to the meek, and seek His refuge:
Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those saints. ॥4॥28॥34॥
ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ; ਨ ਜਾਣੀ. ਰੂੜਾ ॥
Man does not know how to do the beautiful work of his own home;
the fool is absorbed in false affairs. ॥1॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
As You attach us, so are we attached.
ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When You give it, we chant Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
The Lord's servants are dyed in the Lord's love,
drunk night and day on the Lord's sublime essence. ॥2॥
Taking them by the arm, God Himself has pulled them out,
and reunited those separated for countless births. ॥3॥
O Master God, show mercy and save me;
servant Nanak has come to Your refuge and Your door. ॥4॥29॥35॥
The one who by the Guru's grace has found the unshakeable home within
has every comfort and never wavers again. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
Those who, meditating on the Guru, have recognised the Lord's feet within the mind,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਤੈ; ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Creator has made them steady. ॥1॥ Rahao
Singing the praises of the eternal, imperishable Lord,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
the noose of Death is cut away. ॥2॥
Those whom He in His mercy attaches to the hem of His robe,
Nanak, sing His praises and are ever in bliss. ॥3॥30॥36॥
The words of the Guru's Bani are amrit.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ. ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever meditates on it attains the supreme state, and ever chants the Lord's Name with the tongue. ॥1॥ Rahao
The sufferings of this troubled age are erased,
and the One Name enters the mind. ॥1॥
Those who have applied the dust of the Guru's feet to their face and forehead,
Nanak, are saved in the refuge of the Lord and the Guru. ॥2॥31॥37॥
O merciful Lord of the Universe, may I sing Your praises.
O perfectly merciful One, grant me Your vision. ॥ Rahao
In Your mercy You alone sustain us.
Soul and body are all Your capital. ॥1॥
Chant the amrit Name; it alone goes with you.
Nanak begs for the dust of the saints' feet. ॥2॥32॥38॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Without Him there is no other.
The True Lord Himself is the support of all. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is my support,
the Cause of causes, all-powerful and infinite. ॥1॥ Rahao
He removes all illness and makes one healthy and new,
Nanak, the one whose protector He Himself has become. ॥2॥33॥39॥
745: Everyone longs for the vision of the Lord,
but it is received only by perfect good fortune. ॥ Rahao
ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ; ਨੀਦ. ਕਿਉ ਆਈ ॥
Why did I forsake the beautiful dark-hued Lord and fall asleep?
The demons of vice attached me to the great enticer, Maya. ॥1॥
Separation from love acts like a butcher;
ਨਿਰਦੈ ਜੰਤੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
it is a merciless creature with no compassion. ॥2॥
Countless lifetimes have passed in wandering.
ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਦੇਵੈ; ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Treacherous Maya does not let me dwell in the home of my heart. ॥3॥
Day and night I receive the fruit of my own deeds.
ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ. ਨ ਦੀਜੈ; ਕਿਰਤੁ ਭਵਾਈ ॥੪॥
No one else can be blamed; my own past actions make me wander. ॥4॥
Listen, O friends, saints and brothers:
Nanak: in the refuge of His feet the supreme state is found. ॥5॥34॥40॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਛਾਪਰੀ; ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
Fine and beautiful is the hut in which the Lord's praises are sung.
ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਧਉਲਹਰ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Of no use are the mansions in which the Lord is forgotten. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਨਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
There is bliss even in poverty in the holy congregation, where God comes to mind.
ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
Let such greatness burn that keeps one clinging to Maya. ॥1॥
ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਸਿ. ਓਢਿ ਕਾਮਰੀ; ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ ॥
Grinding corn at the mill and wearing a coarse blanket, there is peace and the mind is content.
ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜੁ. ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
Of no use is such a kingdom in which one is never satisfied. ॥2॥
ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ; ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
The one who wanders naked in the love of the One is honoured,
ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ; ਜਿਹ ਰਚਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
while silks and satins are useless if one is lured into greed by them. ॥3॥
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
O God, everything is in Your hands; You Yourself act and cause others to act.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
Nanak: may I receive this gift, to remember You with every breath. ॥4॥1॥41॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਪਰਾਨ ਧਨ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
I would give my life and wealth to the Lord's saint, and be his water-carrier.
ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ; ਜੀਅ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
May he be dearer to me than brothers, friends and sons, dearer even than my life. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਾ; ਸੰਤ. ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
I would make a fan of my hair and wave it over the saint.
ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ. ਚਰਣ ਤਲਿ; ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
I would bow my head at his feet and apply their dust to my face. ॥1॥
ਮਿਸਟ ਬਚਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ; ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
I would pray to him with sweet words, like a humble beggar,
ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ. ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਉ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
and giving up pride, seek his refuge and find the Lord, the treasure of virtues. ॥2॥
ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਉ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Again and again I would behold the sight of the Lord's servant,
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਉ; ਬੰਦਉ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
water my mind with his amrit words, and bow to him again and again. ॥3॥
ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਉ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ ॥
In my mind I hope and long for the company of Your servant.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ; ਦਾਸ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੨॥
O God, show mercy to Nanak, that he may stay at the feet of Your servants. ॥4॥2॥42॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ; ਤਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
The Maya that has enticed the worlds and continents holds me in its grip too.
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਇਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ; ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Save this sinful soul and give me Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੀ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
I run after that from which no one has found peace.
ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਉ ॥੧॥
Again and again I cling to what leaves everyone behind. ॥1॥
ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ; ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O Lord of compassion, show mercy, that I may sing Your praises.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੩॥
Nanak prays, O God, to remain absorbed in the holy congregation. ॥2॥3॥43॥
746: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The greatest of all loves is love for the enticing Beloved Lord.
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਏਕੈ. ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ; ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ. ਮਨਹਿ ਛਾਡੁ, ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, chant the One Lord of the Universe alone; nothing else counts. Cling to the saints, and abandon the crooked path of double-mindedness. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਹਰੀਆ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਧਰੀਆ; ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀਆ. ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ, ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
The formless Lord took on the world of the three qualities, and made many separate chambers of bodies.
Within each, He made the mind the watchman.
The Beloved dwells in His own temple within,
He does not die, nor does He grow old. ॥1॥
ਕਿਰਤਨਿ ਜੁਰੀਆ. ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੀਆ; ਪਰ ਕਉ ਹਿਰੀਆ ॥
The mortal is attached to the creation, wanders in many ways, and eyes what belongs to others,
Now, joining the company of the Guru,
he stands at the Lord's door
Nanak: the one who meets the Guru
The Lord has made the world an arena for His play;
He has fashioned this whole expanse. ॥1॥ Rahao
In it are countless forms and colours of many kinds.
He watches it with delight, and enjoys its pleasures without tiring.
He tastes all delights, yet remains detached. ॥1॥
ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
You have no colour or mark, no face or beard.
Nanak begs for the dust of the saints' feet. ॥2॥2॥45॥
I have come to You, I have come to Your refuge.
I have come trusting that You will show mercy.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Master, save me as it pleases You; the Guru has shown me the way to You. ॥1॥ Rahao
Maya is utterly treacherous and hard to cross,
tossing one about like a gale. ॥1॥
I am frightened just hearing of it,
that the Righteous Judge is so stern. ॥2॥
The world is a deep, dark well,
I have taken the support of the Guru;
Nanak: I meditate on the Lord,
and now I have found the Perfect One. ॥4॥3॥46॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ; ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
I pray to the True Guru that I may receive the support of the Name.
ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
When the True King is pleased, the fever of the world departs. ॥1॥
ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ. ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ; ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are the support of the devotees and the shelter of the saints, O true Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
True are Your provisions, true is Your court,
ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਖਾਜੀਨਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
true are Your treasures, and true is Your expanse. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Your form is unreachable, and Your vision beyond compare.
ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
I am a sacrifice to Your servants who love the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
747: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ; ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
All desires are fulfilled when the unreachable, infinite Lord is found.
ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਤੇਰਿਆ ਚਰਣਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
Meeting Guru Nanak, one meets the Supreme Lord; I am a sacrifice to Your feet. ॥4॥1॥47॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ. ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਹਿ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
You Yourself make those obey Your will on whom You are merciful.
ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ. ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
That alone is devotion which pleases You; You are the Sustainer of all beings. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
O my Lord and King, the saints lean on You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever pleases You is accepted by them; You alone are the support of their mind and body. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
You are kind and merciful, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of desires.
ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਤੂੰ. ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Master of life, Beloved, all Your devotees are dear to You, and You are dear to them. ॥2॥
ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ; ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
You are unfathomable, infinite and most lofty; there is no other like You.
ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
O Master, Giver of peace, this is our prayer: that we may never forget You. ॥3॥
ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
If it pleases You, my Master, may I sing Your praises day and night with every breath.
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name; O Master, if You are pleased, I will receive it. ॥4॥1॥48॥
ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ; ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
How wondrous is that place of Yours where You are never forgotten,
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧॥
where I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day and the body becomes pure. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
O my Lord, I set out to search for that place.
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਤਿਨੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Searching and searching, I found the company of the holy, and in their refuge I found You. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ; ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Reading the Vedas, the Brahmas grew weary, yet could not find even a tiny part of Your worth.
ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ; ਤੇ ਭੀ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Seekers and adepts wander crying out, but they too are enticed by Maya. ॥2॥
ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ. ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ; ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
The ten incarnations were honoured as kings, and Shiva became a renowned renunciate,
ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੇਰਾ; ਲਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
yet even they did not find Your limit, though they grew weary smearing ashes on themselves. ॥3॥
ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
The saints who sang the Lord's song of joy enjoyed poise, peace, bliss and the taste of the Name.
ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
Nanak: when they met the Guru, whose vision bears fruit, they meditated on the Lord in mind and body. ॥4॥2॥49॥
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡ. ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਲੂਟੈ ॥
Death the tax-collector plunders those seen performing rituals and religious show.
ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥
Free of desire, sing the praises of the Creator; remembering Him even for an instant, one is freed. ॥1॥
O saints, the world-ocean can be crossed.
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever practises the teaching of the saints crosses over by the Guru's grace. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ; ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
Bathing at millions of pilgrimages, one is only smeared with filth in this world.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
The one who sings the Lord's praises in the holy congregation becomes pure. ॥2॥
ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ; ਇਨੑ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
The Vedas, the Semitic scriptures, the Smritis and Shastras: reading these does not bring liberation.
ਏਕੁ ਅਖਰੁ. ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
The one who through the Guru chants the Word of the One gains spotless glory. ॥3॥
ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ; ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ ॥
Kshatriya, Brahmin, Shudra and Vaishya: the teaching is the same for all four castes.
748: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ, ਉਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ, ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਝਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
Whoever through the Guru chants the Name is saved in this age; Nanak, that one sees the Lord in every heart. ॥4॥3॥50॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਹਿ; ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Whatever He does, they accept as God's doing; they are dyed in the love of the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ; ਜਿਨੑ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Those who have come to know God's feet are honoured everywhere. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
O my Lord, none is as great as Your saints.
ਭਗਤਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The devotees are in love with their God, and see Him pervading water, land and sky. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ. ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੈ; ਜਮੁ. ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇੜਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Even one guilty of millions of wrongs is saved in the company of the saints, and Death does not come near.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Those separated from the Lord for countless births, the saint brings back and unites with Him. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ; ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ॥
Whoever comes to the saints' refuge has attachment to Maya, doubt and fear cut away.
ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ; ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Whatever wish one worships with, that one receives through the saints. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ. ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨਉ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
How much can I describe the glory of the servants who are pleasing to their God?
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
Says Nanak: those who have met the True Guru have become free of dependence on anyone. ॥4॥4॥51॥
ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ. ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Giving them Your hand, You saved from the great fire those who sought Your refuge.
ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Your honour and strength are in their hearts; they have given up hope in any other. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ਉਬਰੇ ॥
O my Lord and King, when You come to mind, people are saved.
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are their support and their trust; chanting Your Name, they are saved. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ, ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਤੁਮੑ; ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
You Yourself became merciful and pulled them out of the dark well.
ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ; ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Caring for them, You gave them every comfort; the Lord Himself sustains them. ॥2॥
ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
On whom the Supreme Lord casts His glance, He cuts their bonds and sets them free.
ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ; ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
God Himself makes them worship Him and Himself attaches them to His service. ॥3॥
ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ ॥
Doubt is gone, fear and attachment are destroyed, and all anxiety is erased.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ; ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
Nanak: those on whom the Giver of peace showed mercy have met the Perfect True Guru. ॥4॥5॥52॥
ਜਬ. ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ, ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
When nothing existed, what was the mortal doing? By what deeds did he come into being?
ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ; ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The Lord Himself staged the creation; He makes His own play and beholds it. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
O my Lord and King, I can do nothing by myself.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He Himself is the Doer and makes all act; He pervades all. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ. ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਤਹੂ; ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
If its account were reckoned, this ignorant, perishable body could never be cleared.
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ; ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
O God, Creator, show mercy; Your forgiveness is unique. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
All beings are Your creation; in every heart You alone are meditated upon.
ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Only You know Your state and extent; the worth of Your creation cannot be found. ॥3॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ; ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
I am without virtue, foolish, ignorant and without understanding; I know no religious deeds.
ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੩॥
Show mercy, that Nanak may sing Your praises and Your will may seem sweet. ॥4॥6॥53॥
749: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ; ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
O Lord, Your saints are fortunate, for in their homes is the wealth of the Lord's Name.
ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਣੀ ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ; ਸਫਲ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
I count their coming into the world as approved, and all their deeds are fruitful. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the Lord's servants.
ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ; ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I would make a whisk of my hair and wave it over them, and apply the dust of their feet to my face. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਆਏ ॥
They are beyond both birth and death; they come into the world to do good to others.
ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Giving the gift of spiritual life, they attach people to devotion and unite them with the Lord. ॥2॥
ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ; ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
True is their command and true their sovereignty; they are dyed in the love of the True One.
ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
True is their peace and true their glory; the One to whom they belong knows their worth. ॥3॥
ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
I would wave the fan, carry water and grind corn for the Lord's servants.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
Nanak's prayer to God is that he may behold Your servants. ॥4॥7॥54॥
O Supreme Lord, Transcendent Lord, True Guru, You Yourself are the Creator.
ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet and is a sacrifice to Your vision. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
O my Lord and King, as You keep us, so we live.
ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When it pleases You, You make us chant the Name; we receive only the peace You give. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
Liberation, worldly fulfilment and the right way of life are in Your service, which only those whom You inspire perform.
ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ. ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇਹਿ ॥੨॥
Where Your praises are sung, that is heaven; You Yourself instil faith. ॥2॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
Remembering the Name again and again, I live, and my body and mind are delighted.
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
O my True Guru, merciful to the meek, I wash Your lotus feet and drink the water. ॥3॥
ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਉਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that blessed moment when I came to Your door.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੫॥
God became merciful to Nanak, and he found the Perfect True Guru. ॥4॥8॥55॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ. ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ. ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
When You come to mind there is great bliss; the one who forgets You dies spiritually.
ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
O Creator, the one on whom You are merciful meditates on You for ever. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ. ਤੂੰ, ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
O my Master, You are the honour of me, the dishonoured.
ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਗੈ; ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I pray before my God: may I live by hearing Your Bani. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
May I become the dust of the feet of Your servants; I am a sacrifice to Your vision.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
May I enshrine their amrit words in my heart, and by Your grace find their company. ॥2॥
ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ. ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਰੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
I have laid my whole inner state before You; there is no other as great as You.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ; ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Only the one whom You attach is attached; that one alone is Your devotee. ॥3॥
ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ. ਮਾਗਉ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨਾ; ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
With palms joined I beg for one gift; if my Master is pleased, I will receive it:
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੬॥
that Nanak may worship You with every breath and sing Your praises twenty-four hours a day. ॥4॥9॥56॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ. ਤੂੰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
O Master, how can the one over whose head You stand suffer pain?
ਬੋਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ, ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ; ਮਰਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
The one drunk on the wine of Maya does not even know how to speak, and death never comes to mind. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਾ. ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
O my Lord and King, You belong to the saints, and the saints belong to You.
750: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ. ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your servant has no fear at all; Death does not come near. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
Those dyed in Your love, O Master, are rid of the pain of birth and death.
ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ. ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
No one can erase Your grace upon them; such is the True Guru's assurance. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ. ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
They meditate on the Name, receive the fruit of peace, and worship You twenty-four hours a day.
ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ; ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਲੈ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥੩॥
In Your refuge and with trust in You, they seize and subdue the five villains. ॥3॥
ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ; ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
I knew nothing of wisdom, meditation or good deeds; I did not know Your worth.
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੫੭॥
The True Guru Nanak is the greatest of all, who saved my honour. ॥4॥10॥57॥
ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Leaving everything, I have come to the Guru's refuge; save me, O Saviour.
ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਹਿ. ਤਿਤੁ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ; ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
As You attach us, so we are attached; what can these poor creatures do? ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
O my dear Lord, You are God, the Knower of hearts.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O merciful Divine Guru, show mercy, that I may ever sing the praises of the Master. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ. ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Meditate on your God twenty-four hours a day; by the Guru's grace the terrifying ocean is crossed.
ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ; ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Giving up self-conceit, become the dust of all; in this way one dies while yet alive. ॥2॥
ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Fruitful in the world is the life of the one who chants the Name in the holy congregation.
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੩॥
All the wishes of the one on whom God Himself shows mercy are fulfilled. ॥3॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
O merciful Lord and Master, kind to the meek, I seek Your refuge, O Compassionate One.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
Show mercy and give me Your Name; Nanak begs for the dust of the holy. ॥4॥11॥58॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ; ਮੈ. ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
I am full of faults; I have no virtue at all.
How can I meet my Husband Lord? ॥1॥
ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ; ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
I have no beauty, no captivating eyes,
ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ; ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no noble family or manners, and no sweet speech. ॥1॥ Rahao
The bride who comes adorned with spiritual poise
is happily wed only when she pleases her Husband. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ; ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
He has no form or feature;
the Master cannot be remembered at the last moment if He was forgotten all one's life. ॥3॥
I have no understanding, wisdom or cleverness.
O God, show mercy and attach me to Your feet. ॥4॥
She may be very clever, yet she does not please her Husband,
if she is attached to Maya and lost in doubt. ॥5॥
When ego is gone, then she merges in her Husband.
ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
Then the bride finds her Beloved, the source of the nine treasures. ॥6॥
Separated from You for countless births, I have suffered pain.
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
O Beloved Lord and King, take me by the hand. ॥7॥
ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਹੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Prays Nanak: the Husband Lord is, and ever shall be.
The Beloved enjoys the bride who pleases Him. ॥8॥1॥
